title: Tech Note: 4D for Mobile: Object Field Management

historical_commentary.text: 4D's native mobile app-generation product line (4D for iOS / 4D Mobile) that this note depends on was discontinued; 4D subsequently redirected its mobile/low-code strategy toward Qodly Studio and responsive, ORDA/REST-based web applications rather than generating native iOS/Android binaries directly from a 4D structure. As a result, this note's specific mobile-app-generation workflow is no longer applicable to current 4D development, even though the general underlying concept — using flexible object-attribute fields to model per-record varying data — remains a sound and current data-modeling technique in 4D/ORDA generally, just not via the discontinued mobile pipeline described here.
related_updates: 4D Mobile / 4D for iOS native app-generation product line was discontinued; Qodly Studio and ORDA/REST-based responsive web apps are 4D's current mobile strategy.
